1479-2841-8100-8338.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-8100-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-6798-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6798-8319.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1829-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3698-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3698-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-4871-8168.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5078-5741-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-3249-5268-6112--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2112-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-2112-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1453-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

206-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-7452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

140-1839-3245.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-4613-4679-7220--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-4613-4679-7220--128.description:
Activate Glamermite using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Glamermite to Yenna and causing Glamermite to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1409-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1090-2441-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Rasputin and Restoration Angel.
Cast Rasputin from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Rasputin's first ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2872-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

1766-1987-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1283-1456-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1409-3470-6763-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3470-6763-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

1061-1476-6787.easyPrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing and/or control nine or more permanents.
You have not created any tokens this turn.
1061-1476-6787.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Legion Warboss triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator due to Moonlit Meditation and giving that token haste until end of turn.
If you do not have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token will give you the city's blessing.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

969-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

575-5284-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5284-5971.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Blood Vassal dies, Yedora triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Blood Vassal enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blood Vassal by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Blood Vassal face-up.
Repeat.

38-1453-2420.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-1453-2420.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

1819-6003.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to an opponent.
1819-6003.description:
Attempt to deal damage to an opponent.
The damage is replaced by The Mindskinner, instead causing each opponent to mill that many cards.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card put into your graveyard.
Resolve the first trigger, attempting to deal 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 2.
1819-6003.notes: This combo ends once all triggers have resolved and opponents have not milled any creature cards. You can then attempt to deal damage again to restart the combo, if needed. Dealing a larger amount of damage, such as having The Mindskinner and other creatures attack, ensures a larger amount of iterations.

176-2292-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-2292-5522.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2492-2845-3296-3556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
2492-2845-3296-3556.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}, causing each player to copy each instant or sorcery spell they cast this turn.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Hag Hedge-Mage.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Hag Hedge-Mage.
When Hag Hedge-Mage enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Hag Hedge-Mage.
Quintorius Kand and Bonus Round trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

396-1651-2751-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
396-1651-2751-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

1812-2440-2714-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.
Resolve all four Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {16}.
Activate Prismite four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
